description: Erection of a single storey rear and infill extension,  rear outrigger roof extension with solar panels to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Location Plan, Design and Access Statement, T/AA 23 3 01, T/AA 23 3 02, T/AA 23 3 03, T/AA 23 3 04, T/AA 23 3 05, T/AA 23 3 06, T/AA 23 3 07, T/AA 23 3 08, T/AA 23 3 09, T/AA 23 3 10, , T/AA 23 4 15, 17T/AA 23 3 16, T/AA 23 3 17, T/AA 23 3 18 Received: 24/04/2023; T/AA 23 3 11 A, T/AA 23 3 12 A, T/AA 23 3 13 A & T/AA 23 3 14 A Received: 01/07/2023

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - Once the solar PV or solar equipment hereby permitted has reached the end of their lifetime they should be removed as soon as reasonably practicable.
